project.name: Chattera :: Platform :: Common Messaging
project.description: Event-bus abstraction (EventPublisher) plus its concrete transport, decided in CHAT-104: RabbitMQ via Spring AMQP (see solution-architecture.md, "Event bus decision - RabbitMQ"). Services that depend on this module and have spring-boot-starter-amqp on the classpath (transitively pulled in here) get an EventPublisher<DomainEvent> bean auto-configured for free, publishing to a shared topic exchange keyed by the caller-supplied routing key - the same auto-configuration pattern common-security uses for JWT handling.
